arena.slam_coming: Slam incoming — be on a streak of {{streak}}

lair.pitch: One endless fight. Every phase the spider molts into a faster form with a new drill — see how far you get.

sword.title: Charge your sword
sword.body: Every hit charges it: dead on 4, on time 3, close 2, loose 1. A miss shatters the charge.

strike.title: Strike
strike.body: A full sword strikes on its own — harder the longer your streak, up to ×2 at {{max}} in a row.

bite.title: Every miss is a bite
bite.body: A missed note costs HP. Run out and the run is over.

slam.title: Block the slam
slam.body: From phase {{slams}} the spider winds up slams. Be on a streak of {{parry}} when one lands to block it — a block half-charges your sword.

endless.title: Endless and random
endless.body: Clear a phase's HP and the spider molts: a random finger order, route, position and rhythm, faster every time. Every phase cleared heals you {{heal}} HP.

draft.title: Pick a boon
draft.body: After every phase you take one of three boons dealt at random — armor, a sharper blade, a slower tempo… Some stack, the rare ones come seldom. One reroll per run, another every five phases.

threats.title: It learns
threats.body: From phase {{weak}} it shows weak spots — your sword charges ×{{weakCharge}} while one is open. From phase {{affix}} it gains powers: venom, regeneration, frenzy and webs spat over the tab, more of them the further you get.

lifesteal.name: Lifesteal
lifesteal.body: Every strike heals you {{lifestealHp}} HP. Stacks.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.body: Every bite costs the spider {{thornsPercent}}% of the phase's HP. Stacks.

secondWind.name: Second wind
secondWind.body: {{secondWindMisses}} misses each phase are forgiven: no bite, the streak and the charge stay.

steadyHand.name: Steady hand
steadyHand.body: Block slams with a streak of just {{steadyHandStreak}}.

clearSight.name: Clear sight
clearSight.body: Webs over the tab last half as long.

lightBlade.name: Light blade
lightBlade.body: Your sword fills with {{lightBladePercent}}% fewer points. Stacks.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.body: Your streak reaches ×2 at {{momentumStreak}} in a row instead of 48.

exploit.name: Exploit
exploit.body: Weak spots charge your sword ×{{exploitCharge}} and stay open longer.

slowDown.name: Slow down
slowDown.body: −{{slowDownBpm}} BPM on every phase from now on.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.body: +{{overdriveBpm}} BPM on every phase, but strikes deal {{overdrivePercent}}% more.

briefing.title: What changes
briefing.same_speed: Notes come at the same speed
